subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android retire the separate Voice destination and make Chat the durable entry point for realtime Talk, including legacy Voice-route normalization?
rationale: This is a user-facing navigation and workflow change, not a mechanically determined bug fix; tests can verify routing but cannot decide whether the revised product model is the intended upgrade contract.

options.title: Approve unified Chat Talk
options.body: Adopt Chat as the canonical realtime Talk surface after final-head proof demonstrates both dictation and configured-provider Talk flows.

options.title: Keep Voice as a destination
options.body: Retain the separate Voice destination and limit this PR to dictation/composer improvements until a broader navigation decision is made.

recommendation.title: Approve unified Chat Talk
recommendation.body: Adopt Chat as the canonical realtime Talk surface after final-head proof demonstrates both dictation and configured-provider Talk flows.
